results.content: In what has become a September tradition, Apple has announced its annual iPhone event for 9 September 2026, at 10 AM Pacific Time. You can stream it from Apple’s website, through the Apple TV app, or on YouTube, and Apple provides an easy way to add it to your calendar. [...] This event will be the first product launch under new CEO John Ternus, who takes over from Tim Cook on 1 September 2026 (see “John Ternus to Lead Apple as Tim Cook Becomes Executive Chairman,” 20 April 2026). The former hardware chief will presumably be eager to make a strong first impression, and the rumor mill suggests he’ll have plenty of material to work with. The star of the show may be Apple’s first foldable iPhon

We'll also get new Apple Watches, a new set of AirPods, and possibly some other surprises.
